review:
A horror carnival hosted by Lester and Jester, on a 6x5 grid with drop cascades and all-scatter wins.

Every win in a round goes into a Total Win Bar, and any activated Klown Multipliers hit that total at the end. Needle Boxes clear symbols once the grid settles – low boxes remove every low symbol and pay 0.1x the bet for each, high boxes do the same for premiums. 10,000x max in every mode; Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP or volatility outside the game.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
